dataset_block_population.selection: rank all eligible non-calibration offsets by sha256(selection_key/dataset-offset/offset), then take the first J

trajectory_seed_rule: for trajectory index i, derive a positive 31-bit seed from sha256(selection_key/trajectory-seed/i/nonce), rejecting zero, duplicates and calibration seeds

state_selection.rule: within each trajectory and phase, take the eight lowest sha256(namespace/trajectory_id/phase/optimizer_step) ranks

materialization_rule: J must come from a valid frozen precision plan; the builder may use J but may not read any calibration mean/sign or any confirmation outcome
population_scope: synthetic arithmetic 64-prompt blocks and training seeds generated by this declared design; not all possible DL training workloads
